post.summary: Prepare a reusable playlist dataset from Spotify track IDs
post.description: Requires a Spotify session. Validates the file, trims case-sensitive IDs and removes duplicates, preserving first-occurrence order. Uses the session token to read Spotify metadata and ReccoBeats to obtain audio measurements. Successful normalized metadata reads are cached within the current backend session for 24 hours, with at most 1000 entries across sessions, and survive later preparation failures. Cache scope comes only from the server-side session ID; body tokens, cache scopes, metadata and extra properties are ignored. Authentication is required even for cache hits. Missing tracks, errors and unusable metadata are not cached; audio measurements are retrieved on every preparation. Backend restart clears the cache. Tracks without metadata or any usable generator measurement are skipped; partial measurements are retained as null and reported separately. Whole-request failures use the shared error contract rather than returning an empty success. If no audio read succeeds and at least one fails for a reason other than expected missing data (404), the original error is propagated, including Retry-After. Expected missing measurements remain per-track gaps. Preparation does not filter requirements, rank tracks or create a Spotify playlist. Reuse the resulting dataset with /generate when criteria change. The current UI invokes preparation on the first Generate click, not on file selection.

requestBody.description: A version-1 JSON file with 1–500 ID entries, counted before deduplication. Maximum body size is 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes).

200.description: Dataset, skipped IDs and incomplete measurements in source order. An empty dataset is a successful preparation result but must not be passed to /generate.

400.description: Invalid file version, ID list or ID format (VALIDATION_ERROR), or malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON).

401.description: Spotify session is missing (SPOTIFY_AUTH_REQUIRED), cannot be renewed (SPOTIFY_REAUTH_REQUIRED), or Spotify rejects access (SPOTIFY_API_ERROR).

403.description: Spotify denies access to the requested data.

413.description: JSON body exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

429.description: An integration reached its request limit, or a local Spotify cooldown rejected the operation without sending a new provider request. Retry-After contains the upstream delay or remaining cooldown when available. Local rejections report upstreamStatus: null.

500.description: Unexpected application error or invalid Spotify OAuth request; diagnostic data is not returned.

502.description: Connection failure, invalid response or upstream error from Spotify or ReccoBeats.

503.description: An integration is temporarily unavailable or Spotify is misconfigured.

504.description: Spotify or ReccoBeats did not respond within the request timeout.

post.summary: Generate a ranked playlist from supplied tracks and audio measurements
post.description: Validates a version-1 dataset of 1–500 tracks, mandatory requirements and fuzzy preferences. Filters requirements before ranking, so rejected tracks cannot return through preference matching. Numeric scores are sorted descending, null scores last. Exact numeric ties use the equally weighted mean closeness of available measurements: high = measurement, low = 1 - measurement, medium = 1 - 2 * abs(measurement - 0.5). Missing measurements and disabled preferences are ignored; equal primary and tie-breaker scores retain source order. Tie-breaking does not change returned match scores. No Spotify session or external API calls are required. Does not read a file or create a Spotify playlist. Additional input properties are ignored.

requestBody.description: JSON body up to 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes). All three sections are required; explicit null disables an individual requirement or preference.

200.description: Ranked accepted tracks with per-feature explanations and rejected tracks with all reasons. An empty ranking, including when every track is rejected, is a successful result.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR for missing body or sections, invalid metadata, duplicate identifiers, measurements or criteria; INVALID_JSON for malformed JSON.

post.summary: Save selected tracks as a new private Spotify playlist
post.description: Requires a Spotify session with playlist-modify-private. An expired token is refreshed before checking its granted permissions. Uses only the session token; accessToken, public, playlistId and extra body fields are ignored. Trims the name and IDs, rejects duplicate IDs after trimming and preserves selection order. Does not fetch track metadata, rerun generation or verify that the submitted IDs belonged to a previous ranking. Creates one new private playlist and writes sequential batches of up to 100 tracks. Returns 201 only after all batches are confirmed. Writes are not automatically retried and an incomplete playlist is not deleted. If creation fails, returns the shared integration error without playlist progress. If adding tracks fails after creation, the error code is PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE and details.progress contains id, name, spotifyUrl, confirmedTrackCount and requestedTrackCount. The confirmed count includes only successful batches; an unconfirmed batch may already have been written. Check the existing playlist before attempting another save, even when a Retry-After header is present. The frontend invokes this endpoint only after the user submits the save form, using the current Top N or manual selection in ranking order. It locks local controls during the write and shows a complete confirmation or validated partial progress without automatically retrying.

requestBody.description: A name and 1–500 unique raw Spotify track IDs in the desired playlist order. Maximum JSON body size is 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes).

201.description: The private playlist was created and all selected tracks were confirmed as added.

400.description: Invalid name or selection (VALIDATION_ERROR), malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON), or a rejected Spotify request. No write is started for local validation failures.

401.description: Missing session (SPOTIFY_AUTH_REQUIRED), session requiring reauthorization (SPOTIFY_REAUTH_REQUIRED), or Spotify rejecting the token. A failure after creation includes PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE and playlist progress.

403.description: The session lacks playlist-modify-private (SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST_PERMISSION_REQUIRED), or Spotify denies access. A failure after creation includes PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE and playlist progress.

413.description: JSON body exceeds the 1 MiB limit. No write is started.

429.description: Spotify reached its request limit, or a local cooldown prevented sending the write. Retry-After contains the upstream delay or remaining cooldown when available; it does not mean a write can be safely repeated. An already created playlist is returned in details.progress.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before further Spotify requests. Check any existing incomplete playlist before another save.

error.message: Nie potwierdzono zapisu wszystkich utworów. Sprawdź utworzoną playlistę przed ponownym zapisem.

500.description: Unexpected application error or invalid OAuth request. After creation, an unexpected add failure returns PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE with progress. Diagnostic data is not exposed.

502.description: Spotify connection failure, invalid response or upstream error. A failure after creation includes PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE and progress.

503.description: Spotify is unavailable or its OAuth client is misconfigured. A failure after creation includes PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE and progress.

504.description: Spotify did not respond within the request timeout. A failure after creation includes PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE; the timed-out write may already have happened.

default.description: Other Spotify request rejection using the shared error contract. After creation, PLAYLIST_SAVE_INCOMPLETE preserves playlist progress.

SessionCookie.name: sessionId
SessionCookie.description: Application session established through the Spotify OAuth flow. The browser sends this HTTP-only cookie automatically.

AudioMeasurementCounts.description: Number of available measurements used as the denominator for each percentage. Missing measurements and failed track reads are excluded.

mode.description: Tracks with a recognized major or minor mode.

liveness.description: Tracks with an available liveness measurement.

instrumentalness.description: Tracks with an available instrumentalness measurement.

speechiness.description: Tracks with an available speechiness measurement.

AudioStats.description: Audio statistics calculated from available measurements. Percentages use their own per-feature denominator: null means no measurements, while zero means measurements exist but none match the category.

majorPercentage.description: Percentage of major-mode tracks among recognized modes; null when there are no mode measurements.

minorPercentage.description: Percentage of minor-mode tracks among recognized modes; null when there are no mode measurements.

liveTrackPercentage.description: Percentage of available liveness measurements greater than 0.8; null when there are none.

instrumentalTrackPercentage.description: Percentage of available instrumentalness measurements greater than 0.5; null when there are none.

speechHeavyTrackPercentage.description: Percentage of available speechiness measurements greater than 0.66; null when there are none.

details.description: Optional public error details, when provided.

PlaylistToSave.description: Selection to save, not a generator dataset. Extra properties are ignored. Names and IDs are trimmed; duplicate IDs after trimming are rejected rather than removed.

name.description: Nonblank playlist name, 1–100 characters after trimming. The upper limit is an application rule, not a claimed Spotify limit.

trackIds.description: Case-sensitive unique IDs in selection order. Duplicates are also checked after trimming.

trackCount.description: Number of tracks confirmed as added after all batches completed.

PlaylistUnitMeasurement.description: A measurement from 0 to 1, or null for unavailable data. Zero is a valid measurement.

PlaylistAudioFeatures.description: All eight fields are required, including when a measurement is unavailable. Extra fields are discarded.

tempo.description: Positive tempo in BPM, or null for unavailable data.

PlaylistTrack.description: Source-independent track metadata and measurements. Text fields are trimmed; extra fields are discarded.

id.description: Unique within the dataset after trimming. Does not have to be a Spotify ID.

PlaylistDataset.description: Version-1 dataset; track IDs must be unique after trimming. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistTrackIdsFile.description: User file containing only Spotify IDs. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; duplicates are removed after trimming without changing case or first-occurrence order. Additional fields are ignored.

PreparedPlaylistDataset.description: Prepared data for subsequent generation, with safe codes for skipped IDs and missing measurements. Does not include access tokens or raw provider diagnostics.

dataset.description: May be empty when no track can be prepared; /generate requires at least one track.

PlaylistTempoRange.description: Inclusive positive BPM bounds compared against the original, unrounded measurement. Min must not exceed max; equal and fractional bounds are accepted. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistRequirements.description: All four fields are required. Null disables a condition; zero remains an active maximum. At most one BPM constraint may be active: tempoRange or targetBpm, never both. The range compares the original measurement; targetBpm compares Math.round(tempo), rounding positive fractions below 0.5 down and fractions from 0.5 up. Measurements are not modified. Every active requirement must be met, and a missing required measurement rejects the track. Extra fields are discarded.

targetBpm.description: Positive integer BPM compared to the rounded tempo measurement, or null to disable. The user's chosen value is not rounded or coerced.

PlaylistPreferenceSetting.description: Exact case-sensitive preference level, or explicit null for no preference. Values are not trimmed or coerced.

PlaylistPreferences.description: All five fields are required. Preferences affect ranking but never reject tracks. Extra fields are discarded.

PlaylistFeatureMatch.description: One active preference. When measurement is null, match is also null. Disabled preferences produce no entry. Low has full membership up to 0.25 and falls to zero at 0.5; medium rises from zero at 0.25 to one at 0.5 and falls to zero at 0.75; high rises from zero at 0.5 to one at 0.75 and stays at one. These thresholds are project parameters, not universal music definitions.

overallMatch.description: Unrounded mean of available matches, with equal weights. Zero counts in the mean; null matches do not. Null means no active preferences or no available matching measurements. Not a probability of liking the track.

featureMatches.description: All active preferences, including missing measurements. Empty when all preferences are disabled. The number of non-null matches relative to this array's length describes completeness; no completeness penalty is applied.

PlaylistTrackRejectionReason.description: Reason for failing an active requirement. All reasons for a rejected track are returned.

GeneratedPlaylist.description: Every supplied track appears in exactly one group. Empty groups are valid. Text metadata is normalized; extra input properties are not returned.

rankedTracks.description: Accepted tracks sorted by descending score; null last. Exact numeric ties use mean closeness to preferred levels across available active measurements, with equal weights and no completeness penalty. Equal primary and tie-breaker scores retain source order. Unscored tracks and no active preferences preserve source order. Returned match scores are unchanged by tie-breaking.

rejectedTracks.description: Rejected tracks and their reasons, retaining source order.

genre.description: First Last.fm top tag; it is not an authoritative genre

genreIsFallback.description: True when tags come from the artist instead of the track
